principles: Lifecycle gates must be enforced by code, not by documentation memory.
Only code-verifiable stories should require Repro-First binding; non-code stories must not be blocked accidentally.
Gate evidence must come from verifiable artifact digests and story bindings, not plain-text claims.
drivers: The requested pro-story gate must become a hard lifecycle constraint.
Existing story-evidence-binding artifacts can represent repro/red-review-to-story binding.
B-1731 is a high-risk lifecycle gate story and needs small, mechanically verifiable steps.

options.name: A: Share a story-evidence-binding gate across IDEA-to-PLAN and DEV entry
pros: Directly covers the requested pre-story lifecycle gate.
Reuses the existing artifact model with focused changes.
Can be proven with hermetic smoke coverage for block and allow behavior.
cons: It is not a complete global story_create block by itself; intake can still create early-phase stories.

options.name: B: Add a global enforce policy directly inside story_create immediately
pros: It is the earliest possible interception point and can stop non-compliant code stories at creation time.
cons: It has higher compatibility risk for bulk creation, experiment stories, and initialization paths without existing binding.
It requires config, bypass reason, and session_brief surfacing, which is broader than the first minimal lifecycle closure.

chosen: A: Share a story-evidence-binding gate across IDEA-to-PLAN and DEV entry
rationale: Start by enforcing the requested pro-story lifecycle gate at the PLAN entry and rechecking the same rule at DEV entry. Keep global story_create enforcement as a later extension or separate story so one change does not alter both creation protocol and phase protocol at once.

preMortem.scenario: A non-code story is blocked by mistake
preMortem.trigger: The classifier uses only priority or type and ignores file declarations
preMortem.consequence: Documentation, research, or management stories cannot advance
preMortem.mitigation: Trigger the hard gate only for checklist files.modify/create/test, bug stories, or code-verifiable high-risk signals

preMortem.scenario: A stale or forged binding is accepted as red-test evidence
preMortem.trigger: The gate checks only artifact existence and skips digest, storyId, or review verdict validation
preMortem.consequence: The gate becomes formal safety theater instead of real evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Validate storyId, subjectBinding, probeDigest, reviewDigest, red-reviewed verdict, and target-bug class

preMortem.scenario: A rollback repair path is stranded
preMortem.trigger: REVIEW-to-DEV or TEST-to-DEV rollback requires a new repro binding
preMortem.consequence: A normal fix cannot return to DEV
preMortem.mitigation: Block first entry into PLAN/DEV and express DEV only; do not block rollback-to-DEV repair transitions
